## Security and privacy

- [ ] Inputs remain local unless a separately documented behavior says otherwise.
- [ ] Source files are preserved by default.
- [ ] Paths, limits, malformed inputs, and output collisions are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic and redistributable.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run validate:docs`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run` when package contents changed
